request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, acoustic guitar, Celtic harp, fiddle, bodhran, flute, serene and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Nations rage in the deep
Kingdoms totter and sleep
He lifts his voice high
The earth melts away
The LORD of hosts stands
The God of Jacob plans
He is our fortress
[Chorus]
Be still and know
I am God
I will be exalted
In the earth so low
Be still and know
I am God
[Verse]
Come see the works done
Desolations at dawn
He makes wars cease
To the ends where we go
He breaks the bow now
Shatters the spear
Burns the chariots
In the fire of fear
[Chorus]
Be still and know
I am God
I will be exalted
In the earth so low
Be still and know
I am God
[Verse]
Among the nations
I will stand
In the earth
I will be grand
The LORD is with us
Jacob's God
Our fortress
[Chorus]
Be still and know
I am God
I will be exalted
In the earth so low
Be still and know
I am God
[Outro]
Be still
Know I am God
